source.name: Colorlib Bootstrap Templates Caseworth
source.rightsEvidence: The pinned repository template is under MIT. Its retained per-template credits identify the bundled photographs as CC0/Public Domain. The MIT license and image credits are included here.

provenance.capture: Pinned local template rendered at 1440px and 390px content widths. Lazy images were loaded; closed off-canvas drawer was hidden only in mobile capture because the library's Bootstrap alpha placed it in the page canvas. No visible source content was edited.
provenance.attribution: Colorlib Bootstrap Templates, MIT. Per-template CC0/Public Domain photo credits retained; source footer visible in screenshots.

referenceDna.annotatedDescription: A calm legal/accountancy practice page opens with a small utility/regulatory strip, quiet navigation, a serif positioning statement, and a portrait/statue image. A two-column practice area ledger is followed by people, transparent fixed-fee table, editorial updates, and an enquiry form with preparation guidance. The legal entities, named professionals, regulators, prices, response times and service claims shown are fictional demo content.

heroGeometry.mode: editorial professional statement beside portrait image
heroGeometry.alignment: left aligned serif promise paired with a right-side vertical image
heroGeometry.viewport: the actual service scope, one contact action and the portrait fit in the first desktop scene

navigationGeometry.mode: fine utility strip and restrained law-practice navigation
navigationGeometry.placement: slim top utility line above a light navigation row
navigationGeometry.mobile: compact wordmark and enquiry action with anchor links in an accessible sheet

typography.scale: medium editorial heading, compact practice labels, readable fee metadata

palette.contrastIntent: restrained professional tone with clear action/input contrast

imageTreatment.mode: single relevant portrait or practice image
imageTreatment.crop: vertical image beside an open hero; small people crops later
imageTreatment.focalPoint: one calm subject anchors the opening without becoming a credential claim

servicePresentation.pattern: two-column ruled practice-area ledger with concise scope note
servicePresentation.interaction: direct practice links and optional fee table filtering

ctaPlacement.primary: initial enquiry in the top navigation and closing form
ctaPlacement.early: next to the hero positioning statement

motion.primitive: small filter/disclosure state for practical tables and FAQs
motion.library: native form controls and browser events
motion.reducedMotion: static practice list, fee table and FAQ answers

rules: put practice statement and action before portrait
convert fee table to labeled facts
pair enquiry form with preparation guidance

prohibitedPatterns: copied legal claims, fees, names, images or regulatory identifiers
invented credentials, jurisdiction, fixed fees, response promise or privilege claim
stock people presented as the client firm's lawyers

requiredSignatureElements.description: measured statement beside one relevant image
accurate fee table or honest alternative explanation
enquiry with matter context and useful preparation note

acceptanceChecks: the practice-area ledger helps route a real enquiry
fees and assumptions are current and client-approved
legal advice content is only sourced from the client
form language does not imply representation before intake
mobile rows and fee details stay readable

review.scope: pinned MIT source, per-template CC0/Public Domain photo evidence, desktop/mobile captures and transferable professional-services mechanics
